title: Symmetric products and finite subset spaces of absolute Lipschitz retracts
summary: We prove that the $Q$th symmetric product of an absolute $λ$-Lipschitz retract, equipped with the bottleneck matching metric, is an absolute $(3Q-2)λ$-Lipschitz retract. This answers a question of De Pauw about the target spaces of Almgren's $Q$-valued maps. We also prove that the space of nonempty subsets with at most $n$ points, equipped with the Hausdorff metric, is an absolute $(6n-5)λ$-Lipschitz retract.
